headline_seed: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children - BBC
draft_text:
Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy's case after jury split 11-1. The 11 favored acquittal; lone holdout Michael Péguy Desronvil said he "didn't have any doubts" Clancy planned the killings. BBC News and CNN both report deliberations ran ~40 hours.

And that's the mews.
